lines: The intruders had been effortlessly defeated by Astaroth, and only two remained.
They were prostrating themselves in unison, so much so that they were practically rubbing their heads against the floor.
「Awww, what a let-down. Even the bugs in the Demon World are a little stronger, you know?」
「The human world sure is peaceful, for you to be able to survive in spite of being so weak.」
「Well, I've no intention of following suit with the locals, though♪ Curse your good-for-nothing selves as you burn to death♪」
Astaroth was about to burn the men, who abjectly prostrated themselves, like they were pieces of trash.
At which point, one of them raised his face with a desperate look.
「P-Please wait!!! Seeing that strength of Onee-san's, I have a favour to ask!!!」
「Who's Onee-san? I am Astaroth. Sorry, but I've no interest in weaklings♪」
At that point, the door burst open again, and this time a group of armed soldiers flooded into the restaurant.
A group of armed soldiers this time. They pointed their guns at――not Astaroth, but the men who were bowing down before her.
